title: 26 第26章 完胜27 第27章 你会后悔的
content_zh:
“出手吧！
我会让你知道神威团的厉害！”
邢立峰双拳凝握，神色如冰山般冷峻。
“峰哥一定会赢得！”
“那还用说，这是肯定的，我只希望峰师兄能够狠狠的教训这小子！”
神威团的弟子都是咬牙切齿的说道，要不是门规限制，他们早就扑上去群殴了。
“你是他们之中最厉害的？”
林轩微笑道。
“是不是最厉害的不重要，不过对付你足够了！”
邢立峰目光如刀，恨不得在林轩身上刺个窟窿。
“邢师兄当然是最厉害的，小子，你怕了吧！
现在想求饶，晚了！”
神威团的弟子纷纷怒喝。
“最厉害的就行，和他们打太没意思，不如这样，你输了的话，他们每人都给我三十贡献点，如何？”
林轩想玩一票大的。
邢立峰身形如山岳般沉稳，他沉声说道：“要是你输了呢？”
“随你们神威团处置。”
“好！”
话音一落，邢立峰大步前冲，右拳挥出，如蛮兽一般，撞向林轩。
狂暴的力量将前方的气流搅乱，形成了一阵疾风。

那拳头之上，有一团流光闪动，隐隐有兽吼声传出，震的空气嗡嗡发颤。
凶猛，狂暴！
四周神威团的弟子们忍不住低喝出来：“好拳法，邢师兄，干翻他！”
林轩神色凝重，这邢立峰的实力比那梁宏还要强大，他不得不全力应付。
他右手握剑，直刺而出，身体的力量和体内灵力完美的融合，这一刻，他将全部的力量凝聚于剑尖之上。
下一刻，黑色长剑与火红的拳头撞在一起。
嘭！
火花四溅，轰鸣声响起。
林轩后退三步，才将那股狂暴的力量卸去，他眼神如剑，充满了战意。
“见鬼了！
他怎么可能挡住邢师兄的拳头？”
“邢师兄可是大力王啊，这小子怎么会没事？我一定是眼花了！”
不少神威团的弟子失声道。
content_en:
"Take action!
I'll show you how powerful the Kamui Group is! "
Xing Lifeng clenched his fists, his expression as cold as an iceberg.
"Brother Feng will definitely win!"
"Needless to say, this is for sure. I only hope that Senior Brother Feng can teach this boy a lesson!"
The disciples of the Shenwei Group gritted their teeth and said that if it were not for the restrictions of the sect rules, they would have pounced on him and started a group fight.
"Are you the best among them?"
Lin Xuan smiled.
"It doesn't matter whether he is the most powerful, but it is enough to deal with you!"
Xing Lifeng's eyes were like a knife, he wanted to stab a hole in Lin Xuan's body.
"Senior Brother Xing is of course the most powerful, boy, are you scared?
I want to beg for mercy now, but it’s too late! "
The disciples of the Divine Power Group shouted angrily.
"The most powerful one will do. It's too boring to fight them. How about this. If you lose, each of them will give me thirty contribution points. How about that?"
Lin Xuan wants to play a big game.
Xing Lifeng's figure was as steady as a mountain. He said in a deep voice, "What if you lose?"
"It's up to you, the Kamui Group."
"Okay!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Xing Lifeng strode forward, swung his right fist out, and hit Lin Xuan like a wild beast.
The violent force disrupted the airflow in front, forming a gust of wind.
Above the fist, there was a flash of light, and there was a faint roar of an animal, making the air buzz and tremble.
Fierce and violent!
The disciples of the Shenwei Group around him couldn't help shouting: "Good boxing skills, Senior Brother Xing, defeat him!"
Lin Xuan looked solemn. Xing Lifeng was stronger than Liang Hong, and he had to deal with it with all his strength.
He held the sword in his right hand and thrust straight out. The strength of his body and the spiritual power in his body were perfectly integrated. At this moment, he concentrated all his strength on the tip of the sword.
The next moment, the black sword collided with the flaming fist.
Bang!
Sparks flew and a roar sounded.
Lin Xuan took three steps back before releasing the violent power. His eyes were like swords, full of fighting intent.
"Damn it!
How could he block Senior Brother Xing's fist? "
"Senior Brother Xing is a powerful king, how could this kid be fine? I must be dazzled!"
Many disciples of the Divine Power Group lost their voices.
